author: staiger
quote:
First of all this game isn't even running stably on a ps5 pro, its dips into the 20 fps zone in high density areas and if you want to play it smoothly you l have input lag.

Then the agenda that this game is trying to promote (women supremacy, extreme idiocracy and other woke ideologies) should have nothing to do with current and future AAA games, it is unfathomably unreasonable to force gamers to pay top prices for an unpolished game that has a modern **** gen z narrative and that doesn't represent the franchise that it is set in. GTA San Andreas was about gangs, GTA IV was about the criminal underworld, GTA V was mostly about heists and showing modern day problems of relationships with people (best shown through Michaels storyline) and then we have GTA VI which is about a relationship between a simp that doesn't do anything without his girlfriend's approval and a an immigrant, karen that treats men like **** and demands that she should be treated like a queen, just because she's an immigrant woman.

We should absolutely disregard this abomination **** because otherwise, in the future we will end up getting more woke slop titles such as this one that cost 80 dollars.
